text: Controls page 3 lists debug cheats (F2 generate land, F3 spawn pawn, F4 spawn coins, F5 spawn wood, F6 teleport pawns) to every new player from the main menu. A new player reading Controls learns they can spawn coins/wood; expected these hidden or behind a dev flag.
Controls page 2 says 'Era box (tap)' before the player has ever seen an Era box; meaningless from the main menu. Also neither the menu nor Controls says what the game's goal is.

First view in world: nearest tree is 15m directly behind the player (state bearing +180) and not on screen; visible trees are ~40m+ away at the horizon edges. Objective 'Walk up to a tree' — a new player walks toward the far trees. Energy starts at 84.8/100, not full, with no explanation. Player is a plain white capsule.

First chop: status says 'Gathered 5 wood and 2 apples from tree.' but Inventory shows Apples: 1 (plus an unmentioned Sapling: 1); energy jumped 81->96. An apple appears to have been eaten automatically with no message. Also the tree vanished after one E press - not obvious the tree was consumed. Floating '+1 app...' text is clipped behind the chronicle panel.
Tip 3 'Gather stone' appears while Objective 1 'Gather wood' is still 5/10 — the tips run ahead of the objective, so the screen tells me two different things to do at once.

Chronicle lines are truncated with '...' ('Una Taylor declared the nation of Eastham, tho...'), and two NPC nations were founded within the first ~25 game seconds; as a newcomer I don't know who Una Taylor is or why it matters.

Objective 2 'Eat something' with energy at 93: there is no Eat key and the Inventory screen (I) is read-only text, so a new player has no way to act on the objective; must just wait for energy to drop. An apple had already been auto-eaten before this objective appeared, which didn't count. Inventory text also draws over the player capsule.

CORRECTION to the Eat note: Objective 2 'Eat something' auto-completed at tick 1853, 52 ticks after it appeared, with no action from me (auto-eat). The '+25 coins' toast was replaced so fast I never saw it; I only noticed coins 235->260 later in Inventory. An objective that completes itself teaches nothing and the reward is invisible.

Small correction: the '+25 coins' toast does persist (still visible at tick ~2200); I missed it because I'd opened Inventory. The real issue stands: objective 2 completes itself with no player action.

Era box reads 'Village: 0/4' (4 = number of requirements) while the expanded checklist's first line is 'Village 0/1' (a settlement count). Two different 'Village' numbers side by side is confusing. Also the tip explaining the goal boxes ('Tip 5 of 5: Your goals') comes last, after I'd already finished two objectives; it would help most as tip 1.

Pressing N created a nation instantly with an auto-generated name 'Northernville' — no prompt to name it or confirm. The Inventory panel jumped from the bottom-left to the centre-bottom when the Era box was expanded (layout shift). The era panel now says 'Sheltered: no siege can begin until the Town era' — first mention of sieges, unexplained and a bit alarming for minute 2.

Pressing F on claimed land gives a clear message ('This land is claimed by Eastham. Found your settlement outside its borders.') but there is no visible border on the ground or map, and Eastham's settlement is ~108m away and not on screen, so I can't tell which way 'outside its borders' is. The bottom bar still offers 'Found Settlement' while it cannot work here. Bottom bar also now has 6 buttons incl. 'Gift Eastham 25 Coins' / 'Denounce Eastham' — diplomacy actions appearing just because I'm standing on their land.

After leaving Eastham's land (status 'You leave the land of Eastham for the wilds.'), F says 'Too close to another settlement.' The nearest settlement is ~160m away (state). The message gives no distance or direction, so I have to guess how far to walk. Expected: 'Too close to Eastham (160m); settlements need Xm apart' or a marker.

Founding worked only after I'd sprinted ~400m+ from spawn: the rule is 200 units from every settlement, and by game-minute 2 there were 8+ NPC settlements around spawn. Objective 4 took 6000 ticks (120 game s), about half of it spent hunting for a legal spot with no guidance. The success status 'Settlement founded. Eastshire resent...' was overwritten within 8 ticks by 'You are back on your own land.', so the success message is effectively never seen.

After founding: the settlement's floating 3D label ('0 here, 0/0 residents') renders huge and clipped at the top of the screen behind the toast and chronicle, and a tree trunk sticks straight through the middle of the new settlement's well/plaza — the tree wasn't cleared.

Inside my settlement: the Season panel overlaps the Player Info panel so the Energy bar is hidden (only 'Role: LEADER' and 'Land' peek out). Settlement Info shows unexplained jargon 'PCIS: 1' and a truncated line 'Next (K): Farm, 25 wood, 10' (cut off at the panel edge). Five panels plus a 6-button bottom bar cover most of the view.

Objective 6 'Build a market stall' appears right as the chronicle says 'A new stall opened in the market of Northernville' and Market Info shows 'Stalls: 1/4, Stalls for Sale: 1' — I already seem to have a stall that I didn't build. Unclear whether the objective is still needed and what 'Stalls for Sale' means. Residents 2/8 also appeared without me recruiting anyone, with no message about who they are.

Objective 6 'Build a market stall' (gather 20 wood + 5 stone, press B) completed by itself at tick 9001, 48 ticks after it appeared, because an NPC opened a stall in my settlement. I never pressed B; I then walked off to mine stone for an objective that was already done. The completion toast was hidden among 'Enter your settlement' messages.

Objective 7 progress bar text is clipped on the left ('mbers 4/10 • Buildings 0/2'). Objective 7 counts 'Members' and 'Buildings 0/2', while the expanded Era checklist for the same goal lists 'Village 0/1, Members 4/10, Stalls 1/2, Day 1/3' — buildings vs stalls, and the Day requirement is missing from the objective. Two panels describing the same goal differently.
Chronicle is spammed by NPC rivalries: all 5 visible lines are 'X and Y have become rivals' between nations I've never met; my own events scroll away within seconds.

Status 'Relations with Eastshire are now Rival.' appeared at ~tick 11000 while I was chopping trees in my own land; I'd never met or interacted with Eastshire (only the earlier hidden 'Eastshire resent a new settlement so near their land', ~400m away). No explanation of what Rival means or what to do.

Inside the settlement after building a Farm: the bottom action bar wraps to two rows and its right end ('Exit Settlement', 'Purchase Food') is covered by the Market Info panel; Market Info is now so long it pushes Season/Player Info off-screen (Energy no longer visible at all). 'Tier: Village (4 buildings)' in Settlement Info while the Era box still says 'Camp' — two different words for progress.

Cannot interact with pawns around my settlement: with Olivia Wood 2.9m away (state) and visibly beside me, E says 'No entities within range to interact with.' and R says 'There is no one within reach to invite.' Reproduced 6 times with 4 different pawns (Olivia Wood, Wendy Wood, Judy Evans, Bella Wilson) at 1.9-4.4m, both on the plaza and 20-30m outside it, ticks 13101-15541. Objective 7 says 'Befriend settlers and press R', so Members 6/10 can't be advanced this way.

By the end of game-day 1 my nation is 'Rival' with Eastshire and 'hostile' with Newland (chronicle: 'Newland and Northernville are now hostile') without me ever meeting either; no explanation of why or what it means for me.

Nations screen on day 1 (game-minute ~5.5): Eastshire is 'Hostile (-51), neighbour' with 11 members and a town, and the header warns 'Hostile neighbours raid and besiege' — I have never interacted with them. Meanwhile Westernham is 'Friendly (+34)' and Oldland '+21', also without my doing anything. NPC nations are at 'town' tier on day 1 while I'm 'Camp'; they progress much faster than a player can. No indication of WHY relations moved.

Full chronicle (Y) reveals 'Eastshire raided Northernville and carried off 5 coins, 5 wood, 5 stone' and 'Newland raided Northernville and carried off 5 coins, 5 wood, 5 stone' on day 1 night. I was never told at the moment (I only noticed my stone/wood shrinking); meanwhile the Era panel reassures 'Sheltered: no siege can begin until the Town era'. A newcomer reads 'sheltered' as safe. The chronicle has 258 entries by the end of day 1 — almost entirely NPC-vs-NPC rivalries/raids.

Correction to the raid note: my personal inventory was not reduced by the raids (wood/stone changes were from crafting an axe); the raids presumably took from the settlement's stores. Point stands: no status/toast when my settlement is raided, and it contradicts 'Sheltered' in the Era panel.

Right after resuming from a save: status 'Your people raided Newland: 5 coins, 5 wood, 5 stone brought home.' My nation raids others automatically with no choice offered to me as leader; as a newcomer I didn't know my members could do that or how to stop it.

G (gift) fails the same way: Frank Roberts 2.3m directly in front of me, 'There is no one within reach to give a gift to.' (tick 18257). Hypothesis from reading the code: pawns counted as 'inside' a settlement (the plaza label says '5 here') are skipped by Environment.getNearestEntityOfType, yet they are still rendered walking around the plaza and nearby — so every pawn a player meets near their own settlement looks interactable but isn't. Members stayed 6/10 for 3+ game minutes, also after opening borders.

Pacing: a game day is ~30000 ticks (10 game minutes; day 1 began at timeOfDay 0.30 and was 0.92 at tick 18497). The Village era requires 'Day 1/3', so even with everything else done the second era can't arrive until ~game-minute 17+. In my first 6 game minutes I finished 6 objectives and then had nothing achievable left (Members blocked, Day gated). Food is trivial: 35 apples hoarded, energy never below 81.

Opening borders (to draw newcomers, as objective 7 hints) soon produced 'Thieves slipped through the open borders of Northernville and took 2 coins and 1 wood.' The Laws screen only says 'Closed: strangers keep away'; it doesn't say Open brings newcomers or thieves, so the trade-off is invisible until it bites. Members still 6/10.

walkto rock then E gathered a tree instead ('Gathered 7 wood ... from tree') because a tree was also within 5 units and trees outrank rocks; in a forest, mining a specific rock means first clearing trees around it.

Accidental raid: the bottom bar showed [Leave Nation][Teleport Home][Plant Sapling][Enter Settlement] (screenshot). I clicked 'Enter Settlement' at (638,516) ~1-2 s later and instead got 'You raided a Newham caravan and took 10 stone. Newham will not forget it.' (tick 20469) — a caravan must have come into range and the bar re-laid out under the cursor, putting a hostile action where a harmless one was. An irreversible diplomatic action should never sit in a shifting button row and has no confirmation.

H (Teleport home) put me 9m from my settlement's centre, so the following E said 'No entities within range to interact with.' and I couldn't enter until I walked closer. Expected Teleport home to land within the 5-unit enter range (or inside).
